_readme: Numa's monthly and seasonal rhythm for Mobile, AL (Central time), from docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md (offer windows, seasonal anchors) and R4 (offer timing). strategy.py plan resolves each moment to dates for the planned month and attaches it to the slots it fits; the week's sales post prefers an `offer` window. Dates are computed (Mardi Gras = Easter - 47 days; holidays by rule), never hard-coded per year. Closures and event dates are not here: they come from brand.json (closures, offerings.events) and the plan inputs. A holiday is flagged `possible_closure` so the Director checks it; holiday weeks and December 20 - January 5 are scored but kept out of learning decisions (R6).

monthly.name: Month start (paydays)
monthly.what: Offer window: days 1-5 (R2) and the first week (R4 rule 2).

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (InMarket 2024 Payday InSights: spending +33% on payday; Gallup payday weeks)
evidence.notes: Measured for consumer spending; no Instagram study links offer timing to bookings. The offer_week arm learns Numa's own answer.

monthly.name: Mid-month (paydays)
monthly.what: Second offer window around the 14th-16th; final reminder in Stories.

evidence.notes: Spending effect measured; Instagram effect untested.

monthly.name: Last week (next month)
monthly.what: People plan 'next month': an offer reminder fits (R4 rule 2, anecdotal); retention content in weeks 3-4 (R2).

seasonal.name: New Year reset
seasonal.what: Push hardest January 1-10 (teasers from December 26); January wins are provisional until February-March confirms them (R6).
examples: New year, new routine: start with Discover Numa.

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (IHRSA: 12% of US gym sign-ups in January vs 8.3% a month; Bloomberg Second Measure)

seasonal.name: New Year teasers
seasonal.what: Start the January teaser content and offer December 26-31.

seasonal.name: Habit and retention
seasonal.what: Switch to retention content (habit, how members keep showing up) late January to mid-February.

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (resolution drop-off by mid-February: industry blogs, observed not measured)

seasonal.name: Sauna season
seasonal.what: Sauna-led content October-March; swap in a weather hook when the Friday forecast shows a cold front (spec p.34 rule 5).
examples: First cold front of the year. Perfect sauna night.

seasonal.name: Mardi Gras season
seasonal.what: Parade-week recovery content (Mobile's Mardi Gras, February-March); parade days can change hours and parking.
examples: Mardi Gras weekend? Here's your quiet hour.

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (other local hooks: opinion, low confidence)

seasonal.name: Heat season starts
seasonal.what: Start summer cold-plunge education mid-May (median first 90°F day about May 23).

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (NOAA 1991-2020 normals for Mobile: 77.5 days a year at 90°F+, July 22.0, August 21.6)

seasonal.name: Peak heat (cold plunge offers)
seasonal.what: Main cold-plunge offer late June-August; heat-advisory days are same-day Story triggers ('plunge after work today').
examples: 92° and humid in Mobile. Our plunge is 48°.

sources: docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (NOAA normals; NWS Mobile/Pensacola advisory thresholds; the advisory season is an inference)

seasonal.name: September routine reset
seasonal.what: Back-to-routine angle; a secondary sign-up bump reported by gym-industry blogs.

seasonal.name: Hurricane season
seasonal.what: Pre-written open/closed Story templates; storms can close the studio, so check closures before anything that invites people in.
examples: Storm on the way? Our hours are in Stories.

evidence.notes: Season dates are NOAA's official Atlantic dates; the content angle is opinion.

holidays.name: Valentine's Day
holidays.what: 'Bring your partner' date-night content, built for sends.
examples: Date night, but make it sauna.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (design for sends: 'bring your partner' date-night content)

holidays.name: Mother's Day
holidays.what: A gift-an-hour angle only if NUMA sells gift cards (brand.json offerings).

holidays.name: Father's Day
holidays.what: Men's angle (Joseph's 'breathwork for guys who don't do yoga').

holidays.name: Independence Day
holidays.what: Holiday in peak heat; check closures.

holidays.name: Thanksgiving
holidays.what: Holiday; check closures. The week after suits a calm reset post.

holidays.name: New Year's Eve
holidays.what: Teaser for the New Year reset window.

sources: spec p.34 rule 7 (teaser 2-3 days before, recap within 2 days)
docs/research/R2_Formats_and_mix.md section 4 (monthly rhythm, seasonal anchors) (teaser 7-10 days out, reminder at 3 days, countdown Stories, recap within 48 h; opinion)
evidence.notes: The spec's 2-3-day teaser is the planning rule shoot_card.py checks; R2's earlier teaser can run as Stories. Numa Nights runs about every 4 months; Clinical Conversations is cancelled (REVIEW.md). Event dates come from brand.json / the plan inputs, never this file.
